purpose_note: Create a forecast curve for the day. Refine uses the same kitchen sink as blind plus realized price/curve as causal evidence; blind stays immutable.
posterior_rule: R7 turn confirmation: after an early decline, a realized turn-up followed by a large rising-price middle phase establishes a new causal direction even if aggregate flow is near neutral. A small opposite final phase is a giveback unless it reverses the delivered middle-phase move.
lesson: The blind ABSTAIN was reasonable from ambiguous D-1 flow, but refine shows a clean intraday state change: low/turn around 07:48, then +$500 in the middle phase. The late -$60 phase trims the rally without invalidating it.
carry_forward: When prior-flow evidence is ambiguous, do not force continuation. A causal turn plus one dominant delivered phase can become the new chain state; later smaller counter-moves are givebacks unless they erase the turn.
anti_overfit_note: Endpoint is gap + sum of causal phase price changes (-10-80+500-60=350), using the same reconstruction rule as every g24 day.
